# test_late_fee_calculator.py
from datetime import date

import pytest

from late_fee_calculator import LateFeeCalculator  # adjust module name if needed


def test_weekday_days_excludes_weekends():
    calculator = LateFeeCalculator()

    # Friday through Tuesday (end exclusive): Friday + Monday
    assert calculator._weekday_days_between(date(2026, 1, 2), date(2026, 1, 6)) == 2


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("start", "end"),
    [
        (date(2026, 1, 5), date(2026, 1, 5)),  # same day
        (date(2026, 1, 6), date(2026, 1, 5)),  # end before start
    ],
)
def test_weekday_days_returns_zero_when_end_is_not_after_start(start, end):
    calculator = LateFeeCalculator()
    assert calculator._weekday_days_between(start, end) == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("balance_cents", [0, -1])
def test_non_positive_balance_has_no_fee(balance_cents):
    calculator = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2026, 1, 20))

    assert calculator.compute_fee_cents(balance_cents, date(2026, 1, 5)) == 0


def test_no_fee_during_grace_period():
    # Jan 5 through Jan 19 contains exactly 10 weekdays.
    calculator = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2026, 1, 19))

    assert calculator.compute_fee_cents(100_000, date(2026, 1, 5)) == 0


def test_minimum_fee_applies_after_grace_period():
    # 11 weekdays late means one billable day.
    calculator = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2026, 1, 20))

    assert calculator.compute_fee_cents(100_000, date(2026, 1, 5)) == 500


def test_fee_rounds_half_up():
    calculator = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2026, 1, 20))

    # One billable day: 1,001,000 * 0.015 / 30 = 500.5 cents.
    assert calculator.compute_fee_cents(1_001_000, date(2026, 1, 5)) == 501


def test_fee_is_capped_at_25_percent_of_balance():
    calculator = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2026, 1, 1))

    # Sufficient elapsed weekdays to exceed the 25% cap.
    assert calculator.compute_fee_cents(100_000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 25_000
